integrity: The determinant formula is proved analytically by the restriction-class structure and a one-column determinant expansion. Finite numerical checks are used only as consistency tests.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(E_m=(\mathbb Z_m\times\{0\})\cup\{(0,1)\}\).
The exact Riesz ratio of this family is not determined.
Unindexed or differently phrased literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact determinant tightness of the subgroup-plus-one-point family
